{{Attr|Nimble}} (Variable) |ability1 = '''Summon''' - '''Conjurer''' slams its staff. summoning 5 [[Forsaken Skull]]s with a 0.5 second delay between each spawn. |ability1_cooldown = 15 |ability2 = '''{{WikiAb|Cloak}}''' - '''Conjurer''' becomes a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy at half health. }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Got .... another large hostile heading your way ....|audio = TheNightmareRealmWave12-1.ogg|[[Dispatcher]] on Wave 12 ([[The Nightmare Realm]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Conjurer''' was the second boss to appear in [[The Nightmare Realm]] and [[Containment]] as part of the [[Hexscape Event]]. It had a high health and walked at a below average speed. It has [[Freeze Immunity]] and [[Stun Immunity]], while also being a [[Boss]] enemy when it first spawned in [[The Nightmare Realm]], granting it additional immunities for its first appearance. On some waves, it also appeared with [[Bloated]] and [[Nimble]] attributes. The '''Conjurer''' had two abilities. The first ability was ''Summon'', which caused it to slam its staff, summoning five [[Forsaken Skull]]s. Its second ability, ''Cloak'', only happened when it lost half of its health. This turned it into a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy, making it untargetable by towers without hidden detection. ==Appearance== The '''Conjurer''' had light maroon skin. It wore a brown shirt and pants, as well as a light brown scarf, bandages and dark brown gloves. On its head, it wore a grey and light red metal helmet with horns, which resembled a skull. It wore grey and red shoes and padding around its waist. It walked with a staff. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers with hidden detection like the [[Ace Pilot]], [[Gatling Gun]], [[Engineer]] and [[Minigunner]] are strongly recommended to kill the '''Conjurer''' **Towers without hidden detection, like the [[Ranger]], cannot attack it after it loses half of its health, as it becomes a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy. ***The [[Ace Pilot]] can be used to give such towers hidden detections. *The '''Conjurer''' has quite high defense. Because of this, defense dropping towers like the [[Pyromancer]] or [[DJ Booth]] can be useful against it. **As it has the [[Freeze Immunity]], freeze defense dropping towers cannot drop its defense. *Because of its immunities, it cannot be knocked back, frozen or chilled, and it is only slowed down instead of being stunned by stunning towers. **Additionally, when it first spawns it is a [[Boss]] enemy, making it immune to even more forms of stalling. The only towers capable of slowing it down as a [[Boss]] are stunning towers like the [[Electroshocker]] or [[Trapper]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} ConjurerWalk.gif|Walking animation (25 October 2024 – 20 November 2024) ConjurerSummon.gif|''Summon'' animation (25 October 2024 – 20 November 2024) ConjurerThrow.gif|Unused Spell animation ConjurerDeath.gif|Death animation (25 October 2024 – 20 November 2024) }} ==Trivia== *The '''Conjurer''' used the same animations as the [[Fallen Summoner]], and shared the basis of its ability functionality with it. ==Update History== *'''25 October 2024''' - [[v1.38.0]] **'''Conjurer''' added. **{{Bug}} Poison and electric defense dropping does not decrease '''Conjurer's''' defense. *'''30 October 2024''' - [[v1.39.0]] **'''Conjurer''' now appears in [[Containment]]. *'''6 November 2024''' - [[v1.40.0]] **'''Conjurer''' can no longer have its defense dropped while a [[Boss]] enemy. **{{Bugfix}} Poison and electric defense dropping towers now can drop its defense, though the [[Jester]] still cannot drop it. *'''20 November 2024''' - [[v1.42.0]] **'''Conjurer''' removed. ==Notes== {{TheNightmareRealm|[[Blight Walker]]|Wave 10|Conjurer|Wave 12|[[Nightmarish Hulk]]|Wave 13}} {{Containment|[[Cursed Horror]]|Wave 13|Conjurer|Wave 16 (Easy)|hardt2 = Conjurer & [[Enigma (Hexscape)|Enigma]]|hardw2 = Wave 17 (Hard)|[[Enigma (Hexscape)|Enigma]]|Wave 17 (Easy)|hardt3 = [[Eclipsed (Hexscape)|Eclipsed]]|hardw3 = Wave 18 (Hard)}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Conjurer}}
